checks.details: npm run v1:validate accepted the checked-in v1 contract.
node --test scripts/validate-v1-contract.test.mjs passed 26 adversarial contract tests.
The lock covers the required enforcement surface and V1-000 cannot complete without exact-commit independent review attestation.
The validator requires structured blocker proof and keeps blocked slices and criteria out of completed state.
Completed slices require ordered phase evidence and owned criterion evidence bound to the required commit.
